newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Second Chance says IPO 95.6 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Second Chance says IPO 95.6 times subscribed.

text.p: Second Chance Enterprises Ltd, a gold and fashion retailer, said late on Wednesday that the public offer tranche of its initial public offering (IPO) was 95.6 times subscribed.

Second Chance had offered a total of 19 million new shares at Singapore $0.30 each in the IPO, of which 9.5 million shares were available to the general public, for a listing on Singapore's second-board SESDAQ.
Net proceeds from the IPO of about S$5.25 million will be used for the expansion of the group's gold and jewellery business in Singapore.
